display.purpose: Hero headlines on landing and large standalone titles. Defined but not yet rendered in markup.

brand.purpose: The campfire wordmark in the nav. Lowercase, locked, user-select disabled.

body.purpose: Standard reading copy. Cap line length at 60ch.

label.purpose: Nav links, button text, in-product field labels. Always lowercase, wide tracking.

caption.purpose: Footers, system meta, timestamps. Lowercase, 60% opacity.

shadows.name: inset-vignette
shadows.purpose: The only 'shadow' in the system, and it's an inset. Used to frame hero surfaces so a CRT overlay reads as living inside a screen.

motion.name: hover-color
motion.purpose: Standard hover color/opacity transition on buttons and links.

motion.name: hover-underline
motion.purpose: The growing-cyan underline on ghost links — scaleX(0.36 → 1) and opacity(0 → 0.82). System signature interaction.

motion.name: tracking-glitch
motion.purpose: VHS tracking band drift on hero surfaces. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: grain-drift
motion.purpose: Film-grain SVG noise drift on hero surfaces. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The promoted CTA. Ivory fill on black text; on hover the fill swaps to CRT Chroma. No lift, no scale.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ece8df; color: #000000; padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: lowercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #46d4d0; color: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #46d4d0; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Link
components.description: The demoted nav-style link. Muted ivory at rest; on hover the text brightens and a cyan underline grows in from a 36% width baseline. Signature interaction of the system.
components.css: .ds-link-ghost { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0; color: rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.64); font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: lowercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-link-ghost::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -0.18rem; left: 0; height: 1px; background: #46d4d0; opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0.36); transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-link-ghost:hover { color: #ece8df; } .ds-link-ghost:hover::after, .ds-link-ghost:focus-visible::after { opacity: 0.82; transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-link-ghost:focus-visible { color: #ece8df; outline: 1px solid #ece8df; outline-offset: 7px; }

components.name: Brand Wordmark
components.description: The campfire wordmark. Lowercase, locked, wide tracking. Anchors the left of the nav.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-block; color: #ece8df; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: lowercase; user-select: none; }

components.name: Nav Bar
components.description: Horizontal nav with brand left and two actions right (one ghost, one primary). Bottom hairline divider. Gradient from dead-channel to channel-elev.
components.html:
campfire

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 0 2.5rem; height: 80px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #000000 0%, #050505 100%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.13); } .ds-nav-brand { color: #ece8df; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: lowercase; user-select: none; } .ds-nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.75rem; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 0.25rem 0; color: rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.45); font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: lowercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -0.18rem; left: 0; height: 1px; background: #46d4d0; opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0.36); transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ece8df; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { opacity: 0.82; transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-cta { padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem; background: #ece8df; color: #000000; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: lowercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0.25rem; transition: background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #46d4d0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Synthesized per DESIGN.md rules — not yet built in the product. Transparent fill, hairline bottom border only, label above. On focus the bottom border thickens and shifts to CRT Chroma. No box.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; width: 100%; } .ds-field-label { color: #ece8df; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-field-input { padding: 0.5rem 0; background: transparent; color: #ece8df; font-family: 'VT323', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: 0.035em; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.13); outline: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, border-bottom-width 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.42); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom: 2px solid #46d4d0; padding-bottom: calc(0.5rem - 1px); }

components.name: Repertoire List Item
components.description: Synthesized per the 'personal shelf, not catalog' principle. A song entry on the repertoire shelf — title, artist, instrument, separated by hairlines instead of cards.

components.css: .ds-shelf-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.13); list-style: none; } .ds-shelf-title { color: #ece8df; font-family: 'VT323', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: 0.035em; } .ds-shelf-artist { color: rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.64); font-family: 'VT323', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 0.035em; } .ds-shelf-instrument { color: rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.64); font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: lowercase; }

components.name: Hero Band
components.description: Signature surface — a cinematic full-bleed area with stacked CRT overlays (scanlines + grain). aria-hidden; honor prefers-reduced-motion in real implementations.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; min-height: 280px; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 52%, rgba(70, 212, 208, 0.1), transparent 32%), #050505; border: 1px solid rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.13); } .ds-hero-canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1010 0%, #050505 60%, #0a0808 100%); filter: brightness(0.5) contrast(1.2); } .ds-hero-scanlines { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 8px, rgba(204, 51, 68, 0.04) 8px 9px, transparent 9px 20px, rgba(70, 212, 208, 0.035) 20px 21px, transparent 21px 34px); mix-blend-mode: overlay; pointer-events: none; } .ds-hero-vignette { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85) 0%, transparent 12%, transparent 88%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.86) 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 38%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 100%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-hero-frame { position: absolute; inset: 0.8rem; border: 1px solid rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.11); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52), inset 0 0 5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Footer Caption
components.description: The small print at the bottom of a page — system meta, version, alpha disclaimer.
components.css: .ds-caption { margin: 0; color: rgba(236, 232, 223, 0.38); font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: lowercase; }

narrative.overview: A VHS tape someone made for you, watched alone at 2am — the tracking is a hair off, the chroma bleeds a little, the picture is dim but the gesture is loud. campfire's interface is built from that material. Mono type with the friction of an old typewriter ribbon. A warm-dark canvas the color of an off-air channel. Decorative CRT overlays — scanlines, halftone, grain, tracking glitch — that texture the hero but never touch the text. Two color punches (a tracking-error red, a chroma-cyan) used like signal interference: rare, deliberate, never decorative. This system explicitly rejects four neighbors: the saturated-gradient catalogue of a streaming service; the dopamine-fed infinite feed of a public social network; the gamified progress meter of a practice app; the dense tech-blue chrome of a DAW. campfire owns the smallness of being a personal log; its visual language honors that, instead of padding it out.
keyCharacteristics: VHS-warm dark canvas — off-air black with warm-cream ink, never cool blue.
Mono everywhere — Share Tech Mono for display and labels, VT323 for body. No proportional type.
Two-accent restraint — tracking-error red and CRT chroma cyan, ≤10% of any screen.
Flat by default — zero drop shadows. Depth comes from atmosphere (overlays, vignettes), not from elevation.
Hairline-driven layout — 1px dividers at low opacity carry structure where other systems would use cards.
Decorative ≠ functional — CRT overlays are aria-hidden and never overlap text or focus rings.

rules.name: The Interference Rule
rules.body: The red and the cyan are never used together as a paired scheme. They appear in the same scanline overlay because real VHS chroma error does that, but no UI surface should pair them deliberately as 'red + cyan brand'. One signal at a time.

rules.name: The Off-Air Rule
rules.body: The canvas is currently #000000. The shared design laws forbid pure black; the current state is a known compromise carried from the landing's cinematic poster. Future iterations should tint warm toward oklch(10% 0.006 22).

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: Tracking-Error Red and CRT Chroma together must never exceed 10% of any screen's painted area. They are signal, not decoration.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: All UI text is lowercase. The brand is 'campfire', not 'Campfire'. Buttons are 'entrar' and 'criar conta', not 'Entrar'. Exceptions: proper nouns inside user-generated content must respect whatever case the user typed.

rules.name: The Mono-Only Rule
rules.body: No sans, no serif anywhere in the product or the marketing. Share Tech Mono + VT323 is the entire system. Contrast comes from size, weight, letter-spacing, or opacity — never from switching to a proportional face.

rules.name: The 60ch Rule
rules.body: Body text caps at 60ch. Wider lines read as documentation, not as a personal product.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Components never lift on hover. State change is communicated by color, opacity, or by an underline that grows in. Translate, scale, and lift are prohibited as hover affordances. Lifting is a SaaS gesture; campfire is not a card.

rules.name: The Atmosphere-Over-Elevation Rule
rules.body: When a surface needs to feel distinct, reach for canvas-color shift (dead-channel → channel-elev) and a hairline border first. Reach for an inset frame second. Never reach for a drop shadow.

dos: Do use Aged Manual Ivory (#ece8df) as the only text color at full opacity. Demote to ink-muted (#ece8dfa3, 64%) for non-primary copy.
Do use the growing-cyan underline as the canonical hover affordance for any ghost link — it is the system's signature interaction.
Do keep both accents (Tracking Error Red, CRT Chroma) under 10% of painted area on any screen, and never use them together as a paired scheme.
Do prefer hairline dividers (#ece8df21 / #ece8df38) over cards. The first answer to 'how do I group these?' is a 1px line.
Do keep CRT overlays on hero surfaces only — never let scanlines, halftone, or grain overlay form fields, lists, or any dense reading surface.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on every motion you add. Video pauses, animated overlays stop, hover transitions drop to instant.
Do lowercase all UI copy. 'entrar', 'criar conta', 'configurações', 'sair'. Capitals are corporate; lowercase is intimate.
Do stamp focus rings wide and clearly (outline-offset 7px for ghost links, 4px for primary buttons). The dim canvas eats narrow focus rings.
donts: Don't use drop shadows. Anywhere. Depth comes from atmosphere, not elevation.
Don't lift, scale, or translate components on hover. State change is color, opacity, or underline only.
Don't pair Tracking Error Red and CRT Chroma as a deliberate brand scheme.
Don't introduce a sans-serif or serif typeface for any UI purpose. Share Tech Mono + VT323 is the entire system.
Don't capitalize labels, buttons, headings, or copy.
Don't ship CRT overlays (scanlines, halftone, grain, tracking) on any surface that contains text or interactive controls.
Don't look like a streaming service (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music). No saturated gradients, no infinite cover-art grids, no algorithmic recommendation surfaces.
Don't look like a public social network (Instagram, TikTok music, Twitter/X). No engagement metrics exposed, no infinite feeds, no public profiles.
Don't look like a gamified practice app (Yousician, Simply Piano, Fender Play). No streak counters, no level meters, no progress bars on songs, no badges.
Don't look like a DAW (Bandlab, Soundtrap, Ableton, Logic). No mixer surfaces, no timelines, no plugin-rack chrome.
Don't drift into generic SaaS-dashboard look. If you reach for shadcn/ui, MUI, or Chakra defaults, you are about to lose the voice.
Don't carry the four exploratory data-fonts='a|b|c|d' variants forward. Prune them now that the canon is Share Tech Mono + VT323.
Don't keep #000000 forever as the canvas. Migrate toward a warm-tinted near-black (oklch(10% 0.006 22)) on the next intentional pass.
